result:
I have the mechanism confirmed at the pinned commit. Emitting the ranked list.

{
  "contract": "Every public-facing surface that renders a booking or profile page must resolve its visual identity (brandColor, darkBrandColor and the light/dark `theme`) from the owning organisation when the entity behind the page belongs to one, falling back to the entity's own values only outside an organisation — i.e. the org must sit in the branding-resolution chain for personally-owned pages exactly as it already does for team-owned pages. This applies both to the Prisma selects that must actually fetch the organisation's branding columns and to the profile-shaping functions and page props that pick which record's colours and theme are handed to the theming hooks.",
  "defect_location": {
    "repo": "calcom/cal.com",
    "summary": "The single resolution point is `getProfileFromEvent` in packages/features/eventtypes/lib/getPublicEvent.ts:585-614: line 591 computes `const styleProfile = team || event.parent?.team || nonTeamProfile;` and lines 606-608 read `brandColor`/`darkBrandColor`/`theme` off it. For a team event the chain includes the parent org team, which `getPublicEventSelect` fetches at packages/features/eventtypes/lib/getPublicEvent.ts:155-165 (`parent: { select: { team: { select: { theme, brandColor, darkBrandColor } } } }`) — that is why team pages honour org branding. For a personally-owned event `styleProfile` is `nonTeamProfile` (`hosts?.[0]?.user || owner`, line 587), and the user select at packages/features/eventtypes/lib/getPublicEvent.ts:31-50 pulls the user's own `brandColor`/`darkBrandColor`/`theme` while its `organization` sub-select requests only `id, name, slug, bannerUrl` — the org's branding columns are never even loaded, so no org fallback is possible. The dynamic-group branch is the same defect harder: packages/features/eventtypes/lib/getPublicEvent.ts:338-353 hardcodes `brandColor: users[0].brandColor`, `darkBrandColor: users[0].darkBrandColor`, `theme: null`. That profile is what the Booker consumes at packages/platform/atoms/booker/BookerWebWrapper.tsx:203-207, which feeds `useBrandColors` (packages/features/bookings/Booker/utils/use-brand-colors.tsx:5-20), so the personal event page paints user colours and the user theme. The personal profile page repeats it independently: apps/web/server/lib/[user]/getServerSideProps.ts:133-145 builds `profile.theme = user.theme`, `brandColor = user.brandColor ?? DEFAULT_LIGHT_BRAND_COLOR`, `darkBrandColor = user.darkBrandColor ?? DEFAULT_DARK_BRAND_COLOR` with `organization: user.profile.organization` carried alongside but never consulted; apps/web/modules/users/views/users-public-view.tsx:26-29 then calls only `useTheme(profile.theme)` and applies no brand colours at all. The org branding cannot travel on the profile today because the shared shape `OrganizationWithRequestedSlug` in packages/types/UserProfile.d.ts:3-13 is `Pick<Team, \"name\"|\"id\"|\"slug\"|\"calVideoLogo\",\"bannerUrl\">` and the org select in packages/features/profile/repositories/ProfileRepository.ts:44-53 lists `id, slug, name, metadata, logoUrl, bannerUrl, isPlatform, hideBranding` — no `brandColor`, `darkBrandColor` or `theme`; the same omission holds in the user select used by `findUsersByUsername` (packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:103-111, 169-200), which is what both personal pages read through `getUsersInOrgContext` (apps/web/server/lib/[user]/getServerSideProps.ts:201-220, apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:235). By contrast the team page fetches org-capable branding directly (packages/features/ee/teams/lib/getTeamData.ts:34-40) and applies it via apps/web/modules/team/team-view.tsx:36. The precedent for the required fallback already exists for a different org setting: packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-77 lets an organisation's `hideBranding` override the user's own — branding colours and theme have no equivalent. The booking-confirmation page hardcodes the same personal-only rule at apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:150-157 (`theme: (!eventType.team?.name && eventType.users[0]?.theme) || null`, `brandColor: eventType.team ? null : eventType.users[0].brandColor`), fed by the select in apps/web/lib/booking.ts:12-21 which also omits any organisation.",
  },
